text:
leo: quick question for the room — what's the single tiny item you never leave the house without? keys, coffee, chapstick, or something weird?

anya: keys + a pen. you never know when you'll need to sign for a package.

ben: sunglasses even on cloudy days. feels like a superpower.

rachel: reusable mug. i've been known to smuggle full-size coffee into meetings.

leo: @rachel that's commitment. do you have a mug rota?

anya: pen is actually ridiculous but true. left-handed pens are peak.

ops-bot: FYI — office plants in the main lobby are getting watered on Fridays. please avoid leaving food nearby.

ben: sanity check: who here carries a physical map in 2026?

rachel: lol no maps. but i keep a tiny pack of gum most days. helps with plane naps.

leo: tally so far: keys, pen, sunglasses, mug, gum. love the variety.

anya: if anyone wants a spare pen, i keep an emergency stash at my desk. come by and rescue one.

leo: ok thanks team, new personal policy: check pockets for keys and pen before leaving.

ben: meeting adjourned. tiny rituals save the commute.
